svg.title: kaalang diagram for process_batch
svg.desc: Cycles: Process tasks until the queue ends or cancellation is requested. with inputs started, &mut pending, &mut report, policy, &mut self and outputs stop; Retry transient failures; complete on a response, a fatal error, or exhaustion. with inputs mut responses, mut attempt_number, index, &mut self and outputs processed, attempts; Parse each response part; discard the subtotal if any part is malformed. with inputs mut parts, mut subtotal, mut part_index, index, &mut self and outputs checked; Audit every recorded task before returning the report. with inputs mut audit_queue, &mut self and outputs (). Nodes: Start: process_batch with parameters &mut self; jobs: Vec<Job>; policy: Policy handing over self, jobs, policy; Action: Open the batch. capturing &mut self handing over started; Action: Prepare the queue and an empty report. capturing jobs handing over mut pending, mut report; Question: Has the cancellation boundary been reached? capturing policy, &report handing over poll / cancelled described as branch 1: Take another task. / branch 2: Cancel the batch.; Action: Keep the cancellation reason. capturing cancelled handing over reason; Call: Iterator::next capturing poll, &mut pending handing over next; Select: Is another task available? capturing next; Case: Process the task. handing over job; Case: The queue is empty. handing over finished; Action: Keep the normal completion reason. capturing finished handing over reason; Action: Record entry into this task. capturing &job, &report, &mut self handing over index; Select: Where does the task's result come from? capturing job; Case: Use the cached value. handing over cached; Case: Sum local values. handing over local; Case: Try the scripted remote responses. handing over remote; Case: Skip this task. handing over skipped; Case: Reject this task. handing over rejected; Action: Prepare a cached value and its source. capturing cached handing over prepared, origin; Call: Sum the local values without narrowing them. capturing local handing over local_total; Action: Prepare a local value and its source. capturing local_total handing over prepared, origin; Action: Join both prepared wires before accepting the value. capturing prepared, origin, index, &mut self handing over processed, attempts; Action: Prepare the remote attempt queue. capturing remote handing over responses, attempt_number; Question: Is there another scripted response? capturing &responses handing over try_next / exhausted; Action: No attempt can provide a result. capturing exhausted handing over final_result; Action: Acquire a resource for this attempt. capturing try_next, &mut attempt_number, index, &mut self handing over _lease; Call: Read the next response. capturing try_next, &mut responses handing over response; Select: Can this attempt finish the task? capturing response, &responses; Case: A transient failure can be retried. handing over retry; Case: Validate the response parts. handing over payload; Case: A fatal error ends the task. handing over fatal; Case: The final attempt failed. handing over last_failure; Action: Record the retry before releasing its resource. capturing retry, index, &mut self; Action: Prepare the response parts and their running total. capturing payload handing over parts, subtotal, part_index; Call: Iterator::next capturing &mut parts handing over part; Select: Is another response part available? capturing part; Case: Parse this part. handing over text; Case: Every part was valid. handing over complete; Action: Accept the complete response total. capturing complete, subtotal handing over checked_result; Action: Borrow the part for parsing. capturing &text handing over source; Call: str::parse::<i64> capturing source handing over parsed; Select: Did the part contain an integer? capturing parsed; Case: Add the parsed number. handing over number; Case: Reject the entire response. handing over invalid; Action: Accumulate the value and record its position. capturing number, &mut subtotal, &mut part_index, index, &mut self; Action: Keep the malformed part and its position. capturing invalid, text, part_index handing over checked_result; Action: Finish validation while the attempt resource is still alive. capturing checked, index, &mut self handing over final_result; Action: Keep the fatal error without retrying. capturing fatal handing over final_result; Action: The final transient error exhausted the attempts. capturing last_failure handing over final_result; Action: Join local and remote processing before recording the task. capturing processed, attempts, index, &mut self handing over outcome, count; Action: Prepare a skipped outcome. capturing skipped handing over bypassed, bypass_origin; Action: Prepare a rejected outcome. capturing rejected handing over bypassed, bypass_origin; Action: Join both bypass routes before recording the task. capturing bypassed, bypass_origin, index, &mut self handing over outcome, count; Call: Record exactly one outcome and schedule its audit. capturing outcome, count, &mut report, &mut self; Action: Attach the batch's completion reason. capturing stop, mut report handing over result; Action: Take the pending audit records. capturing &mut self handing over audit_queue; Call: Iterator::next capturing &mut audit_queue handing over entry; Select: Is another audit record waiting? capturing entry; Case: Audit the record. handing over record; Case: The audit queue is empty. handing over flushed; Call: Commit the audit record. capturing record, &mut self; Action: Close the batch after all audits. capturing &mut self; End: Report capturing result; Merge: reason; Merge: prepared, origin; Merge: processed, attempts; Merge: final_result; Merge: checked_result; Merge: outcome, count; Merge: bypassed, bypass_origin.
